methods.mms-mix: MMS_FA character CTC, original mono16k audio
methods.mms-vocals: MMS_FA character CTC, HTDemucs isolated vocals resampled16k
methods.wav2vec-mix: wav2vec2 base960h English CTC, original mix; no word-separator tokens in initial diagnostic pass
methods.wav2vec-vocals: wav2vec2 base960h English CTC, isolated vocals, explicit word separators
methods.whisper-large-vocals: Stable Whisper large-v3-turbo transcript-conditioned align_words on supplied text and broad independently transcribed line windows

limitations: MMS mix/vocals are the same model on different input and do not count as independent models.
Character CTC posterior spans are not exact phonetic onset/release certifications, especially for sung vowels and effects.
All boundary candidate spreads over25 ms remain flagged; no full human normal/slow listening is claimed.
Whisper probabilities are text-model probabilities, CTC scores are path probabilities; these are not calibrated accuracy estimates.
Some selected word ends join the next independently selected onset for connected singing; full acoustic end candidates remain available.

openingObservation.unforcedLargeVocalTranscript: Is the sun going down tonight?
openingObservation.interpretation: Vocal phrase is present, but processed wording is misrecognized; preserve user-supplied hook while flagging text and timing uncertainty.
openingObservation.spectrogram: Opening vocal harmonic energy inspected over25.5–36.4 seconds; this is machine visual evidence, not listening.
